meta.description: Pre-written ground team replies for the demo. Shown after the Earth countdown, next to the on-board assessment.
meta.disclaimer: Simulated flight surgeon reply for a hackathon demo. Not medical advice.
meta.arrives: After the mission round trip plus doctor review. ISS 0.5 s, Moon 2.6 s, Mars up to 44 min round trip, solar conjunction no link.

replies.headline: All readings are within your normal limits. No action needed.
replies.diagnosis: No concerns. Your readings match your usual values.
do_now: Carry on with the planned schedule.
Keep up fluids and your exercise session.

replies.headline: Low blood oxygen confirmed. Treat it as low oxygen until proven otherwise.
replies.diagnosis: Blood oxygen is below the safe limit. That fits low oxygen, either from the cabin air or from the body. Check both.
do_now: Put on an oxygen mask from the emergency kit and follow the low-oxygen checklist.
Check the cabin oxygen and carbon dioxide readings. If the cabin air is the cause, move to a module with normal air.
Crew medical officer rechecks blood oxygen every 5 minutes and logs it.
replies.follow_up: Send new readings after 15 minutes on oxygen. If blood oxygen does not recover, the crew medical officer follows the emergency procedure without waiting for us.

replies.headline: Your reaction test shows tiredness after short sleep.
replies.diagnosis: Slower reactions and missed taps after several short nights point to sleep loss, not illness.
do_now: Move safety-critical tasks off your next shift.
Protect a full sleep period tonight.
Re-run the reaction test before any safety-critical task.
replies.follow_up: Send the reaction test result after your next sleep period.
